def factor_gap_reversal_atr(df):
    """Overnight gap reversal normalized by ATR: abnormally large gaps relative to recent volatility tend to mean-revert."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_gap = df_copy["open"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    true_range = np.maximum(high - low, np.maximum(np.abs(high - prev_close), np.abs(low - prev_close)))
    atr = true_range.rolling(60, min_periods=1).mean()
    gap_intensity = overnight_gap / (atr + 1e-12)
    reversal_signal = -gap_intensity
    df_copy["factor_gap_reversal_atr"] = reversal_signal.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_gap_reversal_atr"]
description: Mutation ablates the range asymmetry scaling from the parent crossover. The core overnight gap reversal normalized by ATR is preserved as the sole mechanism. The hypothesis is that large overnight gaps relative to expected volatility (ATR) tend to mean-revert, and the asymmetry modifier may add noise or overfitting. This simpler factor targets improved RankIC and RankICIR while maintaining the parent's strong IC.
